bugs.text: slotPos returns y:e.rowY but rowY is never set (ROWY table unused), so every enemy that reaches its formation slot gets y=NaN: it disappears from the screen and can no longer be hit. The stage can never be cleared and the game soft-locks after the fly-in; the title's demo enemies (704) are invisible for the same reason.
startDive is defined but never called: no enemy ever dives, so no escorts, no tractor beam, no capture, no dual fighter, no 400/800/1600 scoring ever happen.

Bitmap font data is corrupt (glyph strings are not 35 characters and are sliced into 5-char rows), so every piece of text (title, PRESS ENTER, HUD, READY, GAME OVER) renders as unreadable garbage, as the screenshots show.
Mute checks code==='M' but KeyboardEvent.code for the M key is 'KeyM', so the M key never mutes.
The canvas is never scaled: the playfield stays a 224x288 box in the middle of the window instead of filling it.
readyTimer is only decremented while respawnDelay>0, so READY stays on screen permanently from the start of each stage.
Invisible formation enemies keep firing with NaN coordinates; those bullets are never off-screen and accumulate in eShots forever (slow leak over a long session).
Enemy fire rate is very high (1.2 %/frame per entering enemy, 0.4 %/frame in formation) and every bullet is aimed straight at the player; the play-test lost two ships within the first 5 s.
'HIGH SCORE' and 'HIGH <n>' are drawn on top of each other at the same position; the high score value is placed under 1UP instead of under its label.
Enter on the game-over screen starts a new game directly; the game never returns to the title screen.
Game over only at lives<0 gives 4 ships, and the reserve display shows all lives including the one in play (3 at start).
rebuildFlags pushes only one badge of the largest denomination, so the stage badge row is wrong for most stages.
No 'STAGE 1' message before the first stage; showMsg is only called in advanceStage.
Formation columns are assigned at random per row (randi(0,7) once per enemy), so rows can have duplicate columns and enemies would overlap even if the formation were visible.

summary: The file is tidy on the surface: a clear state/update/render split, a fixed-timestep loop, pixel-art sprite grids, a Web Audio mini-engine, and functions named for every Galaga mechanic (dives, escorts, tractor beam, capture, dual fighter, challenging stage). Almost none of it runs. A single missing field (rowY) makes every enemy vanish into NaN the moment it reaches formation, and startDive is never called, so after a few seconds of curved fly-in the player is alone on a tiny unscaled 224x288 canvas with a permanent garbled READY, shooting at nothing while invisible enemies keep firing aimed bullets. The corrupt bitmap font makes all text unreadable and M does not mute. What a player sees is a starfield, a few entering enemies to shoot, then a soft-lock; it looks like a Galaga sketch, not a Galaga clone, and the code gives the impression it was never opened in a browser.
